item.description:
### Blocking has its own place in the sidebar
Blocking is what the app is for, and it sat one tap behind a card on Home. It is now a section of its own, second in the sidebar, so schedules, block lists and time limits are always one click away. Everything that used to open it — the Home card, "More" on the templates row, a running limit in the sessions list — now takes you there.
### You can see when your settings arrive
On a Mac managed by an organisation or by a parent, a change made in the console used to apply in silence: nothing on screen said the device had caught up. A short "Settings updated" note now appears when a sync actually brings something new. It stays quiet the rest of the time, so a normal day shows nothing.
### Smaller things
The Reels & Shorts and other guard cards have a close button, like every other card in the app — clicking outside or pressing Esc always worked, but neither was visible.
When you build a block list, "Add Apps" now looks like the button it is, and "Add" beside the website field no longer sits greyed out — press it with something that isn't a domain and it says so, under the field.
A long name no longer gets cut off at the bottom of the sidebar.
